## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: driver programs, violation surcharges, the point system and interstate compacts
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The manual words the scheduled suspension trigger as between twelve and fourteen points in a twenty-four-month period or more, and says the Driver Improvement Program may be unavailable if points built up within a twenty-four-month period; the dossier reports the trigger as printed and does not interpret the eligibility clause [A01] (verify NJ-PTS-D-NOTICE).
The point chart and surcharge table extracted one row per line with the value on the same line, so their values are used as printed.
Surcharge payment channels (mailing address, website and phone line) are service details kept out of learner facts and treated as dynamic.
The last page of the chapter extracted only a page number and is not used (verify NJ-PTS-D-BLANK).

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 135 says drivers with between 12 and 14 points in a 24-month period or more receive a Notice of Scheduled Suspension and may not be eligible for the Driver Improvement Program if points were accumulated within a 24-month period; confirm the exact trigger and eligibility rule from an official MVC source.
Physical page 143 extracted only a page number and chapter tag; confirm whether it carries image-only content the dossier should cover.
